research.title: AI-Powered Espionage Campaign Targets Government Linux Infrastructure
research.summary: Our analysis an AI-powered espionage campaign targeting government Linux infrastructure with custom malware, web shells, and advanced credential theft. The post AI-Powered Espionage Campaign Targets Government Linux Infrastructure appeared first on Unit 42 .

research.title: CVE-2026-104935 | Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass and Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
research.summary: CVE-2026-104935 is an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. Ivanti assigns it a CVSS 3.1 score of 8.6 (High) and has confirmed exploitation.

python3 <script>.py --target https://<authorized-target>
# confirm exact flags in the linked GitHub README before validation
chains: initial access through exposed the affected product
lateral movement if secrets or management access are recovered
vulns.weaponized: Likely worth tracking because public tooling exists and recent source activity was observed.
